title: GPT-6.1 Sol
summary: GPT-6.1 Sol is now available in Conductor!
html:
GPT-6.1 Sol is now available in Conductor!

OpenAI's upgrade to GPT-6 Sol nearly matches GPT-6 Astra on agentic coding at one-fifth of Astra's price. It's also the new default Codex model.

New in 0.89.2

  • Fixed PR info getting stuck on "Loading PR info…" for repositories on GitHub Enterprise Server 3.21 and earlier.
  • Improved quality of life and edge cases for Sign in with ChatGPT.

New in 0.89.3

  • Fixed chats getting stuck in progress, Stop doing nothing, and model settings being locked on macOS versions before 14.4.

New in 0.89.5

  • Fixed GPT-6.1 Sol failing with "not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account" when you sign in to Codex with ChatGPT.
  • Fixed long chats in local workspaces sometimes taking several seconds to open.
  • Fixed new local workspace branches keeping their placeholder name when enterprise data privacy is on.
  • Updated the bundled Codex to 0.159.3.
markdown:
![GPT-6.1 Sol](/assets/changelog/images/gpt-6-1-sol-0.89.1.png)

GPT-6.1 Sol is now available in Conductor!

OpenAI's upgrade to GPT-6 Sol nearly matches GPT-6 Astra on agentic coding at one-fifth of Astra's price. It's also the new default Codex model.

### New in 0.89.2

- Fixed PR info getting stuck on "Loading PR info…" for repositories on GitHub Enterprise Server 3.21 and earlier.
- Improved quality of life and edge cases for Sign in with ChatGPT.

### New in 0.89.3

- Fixed chats getting stuck in progress, Stop doing nothing, and model settings being locked on macOS versions before 14.4.

### New in 0.89.5

- Fixed GPT-6.1 Sol failing with "not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account" when you sign in to Codex with ChatGPT.
- Fixed long chats in local workspaces sometimes taking several seconds to open.
- Fixed new local workspace branches keeping their placeholder name when enterprise data privacy is on.
- Updated the bundled Codex to 0.159.3.
